rows.text: sets `r9d` to 0x10 and tail-jumps at the site `00270F50` + 0x6 with `rcx`, `rdx` and `r8` passed through unchanged
reads the sign-extended dword `02AEE894` and returns the dword at index that value of the dword array at `02AEE898` (`02AEE898 + value*4`), with no bounds check
clamps `ecx` to the range 1 to 0x1A (signed: values below 1 become 1, values above 0x1A become 0x1A) and returns the dword at index `clamped - 1` of the dword array at `02AEE898`
when `edx` is non-zero ORs 8 into byte `rcx+0x991`; when `edx` is 0 clears that bit instead (AND 0xF7)

notes: 00270F50: the whole body is two instructions (the entry mov and the tail jmp); it is rowed because the tail jump is interior work, with the single anchor on the jmp. If FABLE treats a set-and-forward as entry-only work, skip it.
